newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's to offer Beanies while supplies last.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's to offer Beanies while supplies last.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Friday its restaurants will continue to offer Teenie Beanie Babies as a Happy Meal promotion until supplies run out, and then begin phasing in new promotional programs.
On April 11, McDonald's began offering Teenie Beanie Babies, miniature plush animal toys made by Ty Inc. McDonald's has said the Teenie Beanies may be its most successful Happy Meal promotion ever.
McDonald's had planned to offer 100 million of the Teenie Beanies over five weeks. But the success of the promotion has dried up supplies in some areas in the first week.

"While we anticipated and planned for a very popular promotion, we never imagined the kind of Teenie Beanie mania we've seen from coast to coast," Dean Barrett, McDonald's vice president of marketing, said in a statement.
Barrett said more toys were produced for this program than for any other in McDonald's history.
He added that the Ty Teenie Beanie Babies have become the most sought-after Happy Meal toys in the company's history.
